व्युच्छित्तिः f., व्युच्छेदः Cutting
off, extermination, complete
destruction.

1 Transgression, going
astray.
--2 Inverted order,
contrariety.
--3 Confusion, disorder.

व्युत्क्रांत p. p.
1 Transgressed,
overstepped.
--2 Departed, left, gone
forth.
--3 Neglected.
--ता A kind of
riddle.

To get up, rise.
--2
To increase in strength or power,
grow strong. --Caus. To excite,
instigate, rouse.

व्युत्थानं, व्युत्थितिः f.
1 Great
activity.
--2 Rising up against,
opposition, obstruction.
--3 Independent
action, following one's own bent of
mind.
--4 The completion of religious
abstraction or abstract meditation
(in Yoga phil.).
--5 A kind of dance.
--6 Causing (an elephant) to rise;
Śi. 18. 26.
--7 Contradicting.

व्युत्पत्तिः f.
1 Origin, production.
--2 Derivation, etymology.
--3
Perfect proficiency, conversancy.
--4
Scholarship, learning;
व्युत्पत्तिरावर्जितकोविदापि न रंजनाय क्रमते जडानां

व्युत्पन्न p. p.
1 Produced,
begotten.
--2 Formed by derivation.
--3
Derived, traced to its etymology, as
a word (opp. अव्युत्पन्न or ‘primitive’).
--4 Completed, perfected;

To throw or
scatter about.

व्युदस्त p. p. Thrown aside,
rejected, cast off.

1 Throwing aside,
rejection.
--2 Exclusion (in gram.).
--3
Prohibition.
--4 Disregard,
indifference.
--5 Killing, destruction;
Śi. 15. 37.

1 Non-cessation.
--2
Inquietude.
--3 Complete cessation
(where वि shows intensity).

व्युष्ट p. p.
1 Burnt.
--2 Dawned,
become day-light.
--3 Become bright
or clear.
--4 Dwelt.
--5 Passed.
--ष्टं
1 Day-break, dawn; Śi. 12. 4.
--2
Day.
--3 Fruit, result.

व्युष्टिः f.
1 Dawn.
--2 Prosperity.
--3 Praise.
--4 Fruit, consequence.

1 Weaving, sewing.
--2 The
wages of weaving.

To arrange troops in
battle array; सूच्या वज्रेण चैवेतान्
व्यूहेन व्यूह्य योधयेत्

.
--2 To
arrange, put or place in order,
dispose.
--3 To separate, divide.
--4 To
alter, transpose, disarrange.
--5 To
resolve (vowels, syllables &c.).

व्यूढ p. p.
1 Expanded, developed,
broad, wide; व्यूढोरस्को वृषस्कंधः

.
--2 Firm, compact.
--3 Placed
in order, arranged, marshalled (as
an army);

.
--4
Disarranged, placed out of order.
--5 Married.
--6 Large, great.
--Comp.
--कंकट a.
mailed, clad in armour.

.
--2 An army, a host, squadron;
व्यूहावुभौ तावितरेतरस्मात् भंगं जयं
चापतुरव्यवस्थं

.
--3 A large
quantity, an assemblage, a multitude,
collection.
--4 A part, portion,
subhead.
--5 The body.
--6 Structure,
formation.
--7 Reasoning, logic.
--8
Separation, distribution.
--9 (In
phil.) A peculiar arrangement of
the senses.
--Comp.
--पार्प्णिः f. the
rear of an army.
